Package com.hkust.marketplace.ui

Class DealText

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.ui.DealText
public final class DealText extends Object
The wording of the My Deals screen (UC7), kept apart from the JavaFX code so it can be unit-tested. How the deal itself reads (type, terms, counter, status) is in OfferText.

    • dates

      public static String dates(Deal deal)
      When the deal was made, accepted and completed, as far as it got: "Made 09 Nov 2026 · Accepted 10 Nov 2026 · Completed 12 Nov 2026". A borrowed item says "Returned" instead of "Completed", or "Returned automatically" when the borrowing period ended (UC12).

    • due

      public static Optional<String> due(Deal deal)
      The due date of a borrowed item that has not been returned yet (UC7 step 2), to the second: "Due 17 Nov 2026 09:00:00". Empty for every other deal.
